content: Create a small editable tabletop scanning rig. Use a circular turntable 70 cm across with its top 24 cm above the floor, and an overhead rectangular light panel centered over it, supported by a freestanding frame with two posts and a crossbeam. Leave exactly 32 cm clear between the turntable top and the underside of the light panel so bulky samples can be inserted. Keep that sample-loading space usable as we develop the rig. Add a separate 40 cm storage cube two meters to the left. Keep the parts separate and choose sensible dimensions for the frame.

The proposed changes have not been saved because verification is incomplete: unavailable: Unverified: An unobstructed sample-loading volume above the circular turntable, extending to the panel underside with an accessible insertion path, requires a relative circular clearance-volume test not expressible by the available fixed world-box region predicate. unavailable: Unverified: Freestanding stability and physical support of the overhead light cannot be certified from geometric contact alone. Your saved project is unchanged.
